# Screenshot the fixture at 900px and verify ok=true
cd /Users/sinchunyeung/github/simplification-of-trajectory-streams
python3 - <<'PY'
import asyncio
from pathlib import Path

async def main():
    from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
    fixture = Path("web/usability/full-green-path.html").resolve().as_uri()
    out = Path("web/usability/full-green-path.png")
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch()
        page = await browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 900, "height": 700})
        await page.goto(fixture)
        text = await page.locator("#check").inner_text()
        print(text)
        await page.screenshot(path=str(out), full_page=True)
        await browser.close()
        print(f"wrote {out} size={out.stat().st_size}")

asyncio.run(main())
PY
# Confirm live index.html label
rg -n "Full green path|Full result path" web/index.html web/viewer.js
